name: no-real-project-test
body: A candidate binary under test is never pointed at a real project — not the apg repo, not any checkout a developer cares about. Every e2e scenario exercises it against a throwaway git repo under `/tmp`, so `init`/`scan`/`project`/`merge` mutations never touch real state. The apg repo's own graph is rebuilt only by the installed (released) binary, never by an in-tree candidate build.
